_hooks_verified_pieces._note: These three things ARE verified and can be used as written.
_hooks_verified_pieces._event_name_source: hooks/protect_raw.py emits this name in its own output, and it is the event the Chapter 20 hook is written for. Verified on 2026-09-18 against Claude Code 2.1.276.
_hooks_verified_pieces._raw_data_hook_behaviour: Reads a JSON payload on standard input. Prints a deny decision and exits 0 when the payload is a write into data/raw. Prints nothing and exits 0 otherwise. Verified on 2026-09-18 against three payloads; see hooks/README.md.
_hooks_verified_pieces._gate_wrapper_behaviour: Runs the gate, passes its output through, and exits 2 when the gate fails so that the hook blocks. Exits 0 when the gate passes. The working directory must be the build directory, because every gate reads its inputs from the current directory. See docs/gates.md for the command for each gate.
